goalWorkflows.goalTitle: Refactor useDrawingCreation into 5 interaction model state machines
goalWorkflows.goalObjective: Refactor useDrawingCreation from the flat switch into 5 distinct interaction model handlers: (1) handleSingleClick for single-point tools, (2) handleTwoClick for two-point tools, (3) handleMultiPoint for N-point tools with Enter/double-click early commit and Escape cancel, (4) handleDrag for drag-based tools with mousedownâmousemove previewâmouseup commit, (5) handleFreehand for brush tools with mousedownâmousemove samplingâmouseup commit (16ms throttle, 500-point cap). Add MULTI_POINT_SPECS config (toolâ{points, minPoints}) for multi-point tools. Add keyboard listeners for Enter to commit multi-point drawings and Escape to cancel any in-progress drawing. Extend DEFAULT_STYLES for all new tools. The commitDrawing function should also accept and persist metadata.

Implement the measure tool as a drag-based drawing that shows a dashed rectangle between two points with Îprice, Îprice%, and Îbars displayed in the center.

Implement the 6 Channel tools â parallel_channel (3-point), regression_channel (2-point with linear regression on candle closes), standard_error_channel (2-point with std-error width), ascending_channel, descending_channel, flat_channel â as interactive drawing tools with proper channel geometry.

Implement the 8 Fibonacci tools â fibonacci retracement, fib_time_zones, fib_speed_resistance_fan, fib_speed_resistance_arcs, fib_circle, fib_spiral, fib_wedge, fib_channels â with correct mathematical level calculations and the specified color palette per level.

Implement the 7 Gann/Pitchfork tools â gann_fan (9 rays from P1), gann_box (rectangle + grid), gann_square (square with diagonals), gann_diamond (45Â° rotated rectangle), andrews_pitchfork, schiff_pitchfork, modified_schiff_pitchfork â with correct geometric construction.

Implement the 11 Pattern skeleton tools (elliott_impulse_wave, elliott_corrective_wave, elliott_triangle, elliott_combo, head_and_shoulders, triangle_pattern, double_top, double_bottom, cypher_pattern, abc_pattern, three_drives) as hand-placed multi-point polyline skeletons with labeled points, using a shared renderPolyline function and PATTERN_SPECS config.

Implement the 3 Position/Forecast tools â long_position (green target rect + red stop rect with RR display), short_position (reverse of long), forecast (trend line + funnel uncertainty band) â as interactive drawing tools with risk/reward calculation.

Implement the 3 drag-based Range tools â range_tool (shows Îbars + Îprice + Îprice%), date_range (shows Îbars + date text), price_range (shows Îprice + Îprice%) â with real-time preview during drag and committed rectangle on mouseup.

Implement the measured_move tool as a 3-point multi-point tool where the second segment equals the first segment in length but direction is determined by the third point, rendered with a dashed projection line.

Implement the 5 Shape tools â ellipse (bounding box), circle (center + radius), rounded_rectangle (bbox + rx/ry=8), triangle_shape (3-point polygon), parallelogram (3-point with auto-computed 4th point) â with semi-transparent fill and solid stroke.

Decomposed 62-tool drawing toolbar completion + style fixes into 24 goals: 3 P0 style bug fixes, 3 infrastructure bootstrap goals, 14 tool implementation goals (covering all 62 placeholder tools across 5 phases), and 4 cross-cutting goals (hit-test, registry migration, E2E tests, final integration). All 23 REQs traced to owning goals.

## Decomposition Analysis
## Goal Boundary Rationale

The 24-goal decomposition follows the PRD's natural phase structure (P0-P5) while separating infrastructure concerns from per-tool-group implementation:

**P0 Style Fixes (3 goals)**: Three independent, zero-dependency goals for the three distinct style bugs (toast/cookie z-index, duplicate testid, flash feedback). Each touches a non-overlapping set of files and can execute in parallel.

**Infrastructure Bootstrap (3 goals)**: Three foundational goals that all tool goals depend on:
- `goal_types_metadata` (REQ-18): Extends DrawingStyle and DrawingObject with metadata â the data contract that every tool goal consumes.
- `goal_creation_state_machine` (REQ-17): Refactors useDrawingCreation into 5 interaction models â the behavioral contract every tool goal needs to register its creation logic.
- `goal_persistence_schema` (REQ-20): Adds metadataJson column and opens toolType validation â P2+ tool goals that produce metadata (fibonacci levels, regression coefficients, etc.) depend on this being in place.

**Tool Implementation (14 goals)**: Each goal covers a cohesive tool group from the PRD, containing tools that share the same interaction model and geometric family. This grouping keeps each goal at a size that Build can complete and verify independently:
- 4 P1 goals (trend/5, annotation/7, icons/2, measure/1 = 15 tools)
- 4 P2 goals (channels/6, fibonacci/8, gann/4, pitchfork/3 = 21 tools)
- 1 P3 goal (patterns/11 tools)
- 4 P4 goals (position/3, range/3, measured_move/1, shapes/5 = 12 tools)
- 1 P5 goal (brushes/3 tools)

Total: 62 tools covered. No tool is simplified, deferred, or dropped.

**Cross-cutting (4 goals)**:
- `goal_hit_test_system` (REQ-19): Depends on all 14 tool goals to add per-type hit-test logic.
- `goal_registry_migration` (REQ-22): Depends on all 14 tool goals to verify placeholder count is zero.
- `goal_e2e_tests` (REQ-21): Depends on tool goals + hit-test for createâselectâdelete workflows.
- `goal_final_integration` (REQ-21/22/23): Terminal integration goal owning typecheck, unit tests, and full render surface verification.

## Why No Goal Is Too Large

Each tool goal contains 1-11 tools of the same geometric family, sharing a common rendering approach. The largest goal (goal_pattern_tools, 11 tools) uses a shared renderPolyline function and PATTERN_SPECS config, making the per-tool implementation incremental. The fibonacci goal (8 tools) shares a common level computation + color palette pattern.

## Dependency Necessity

- P0 goals have no dependencies â they can start immediately.
- Infrastructure goals form a minimal chain: types â creation_state_machine + persistence_schema.
- Tool goals depend on the infrastructure chain because they need: (a) the DrawingMetadata type to store tool-specific data, (b) the state machine to register their interaction model, (c) the persistence schema for metadata round-tripping.
- P2+ tools additionally depend on persistence_schema because they produce critical metadata (fibonacci levels, regression coefficients, pattern labels, position RR) that must survive page refresh.
- Cross-cutting goals depend on all tool goals because they verify correctness of the complete tool set.
- The final integration goal depends on everything as the terminal verification gate.

## Coverage Verification

All 23 REQs are traced to at least one goal:
- REQ-1 â goal_p0_toast_cookie_fix
- REQ-2 â goal_p0_flash_feedback
- REQ-3 â goal_p0_testid_fix
- REQ-4 â goal_trend_tools (5 tools)
- REQ-5 â goal_annotation_tools (7 tools)
- REQ-6 â goal_icon_media_tools (2 tools)
- REQ-7 â goal_measure_tool (1 tool)
- REQ-8 â goal_channel_tools (6 tools)
- REQ-9 â goal_fibonacci_tools (8 tools)
- REQ-10 â goal_gann_tools (4 tools) + goal_pitchfork_tools (3 tools)
- REQ-11 â goal_pattern_tools (11 tools)
- REQ-12 â goal_position_tools (3 tools)
- REQ-13 â goal_range_tools (3 tools)
- REQ-14 â goal_measured_move_tool (1 tool)
- REQ-15 â goal_shape_tools (5 tools)
- REQ-16 â goal_brush_tools (3 tools)
- REQ-17 â goal_creation_state_machine
- REQ-18 â goal_types_metadata
- REQ-19 â goal_hit_test_system
- REQ-20 â goal_persistence_schema
- REQ-21 â goal_e2e_tests + goal_final_integration
- REQ-22 â goal_registry_migration + goal_final_integration
- REQ-23 â all 14 tool goals + goal_final_integration

## Requirements
- **REQ-1** [explicit]: Fix the UnsupportedFeatureToast being visually obscured by the CookieBanner â the toast (z-index 300, bottom: 20px) is completely covered by the cookie banner (z-index 400, bottom: 0, ~50-70px tall). Acceptance: With the cookie banner visible, clicking any placeholder tool shows the toast fully visible above the cookie banner; after accepting/rejecting cookies, the toast returns to bottom: 20px with no overlap. Non-goals: Does not cover redesigning the toast or cookie banner; only fixes the z-index/positioning conflict.
- **REQ-2** [explicit]: Add instant visual click feedback (200ms blue flash animation) to all drawing toolbar buttons, including placeholder tools that are not yet implemented, so users see a response even when toast may be obscured. Acceptance: Clicking any toolbar button (supported or placeholder) triggers a visible 200ms blue flash animation on that button. Non-goals: Does not change the toast behavior or replace the toast; the flash is a supplementary visual cue only.
- **REQ-3** [explicit]: Fix the duplicate data-testid="left-drawing-toolbar" â both the ChartWorkspaceShell outer region container and the inner LeftDrawingToolbar component use the same testid, breaking strict-mode Playwright selectors. Acceptance: page.locator('[data-testid="left-drawing-toolbar"]') returns exactly one element in strict mode; the outer region container uses a distinct testid like "left-drawing-toolbar-region". Non-goals: Does not change other testids or the toolbar's visual appearance; only resolves the duplicate.
- **REQ-4** [explicit]: Implement the 5 Trend group extension tools â ray_line, extended_line, arrow_line, trend_angle, disjoint_angle â as fully interactive drawing tools with correct geometry (ray extends to viewport edge, extended line spans both viewport boundaries, arrow has triangle arrowhead, trend_angle shows arc + degree label, disjoint_angle shows 3-point V with angle). Acceptance: Each of the 5 tools can be placed via their defined click interaction, renders correctly on chart (geometry matches spec), repositions correctly on zoom/pan, and their registry status is 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover editing tool properties after placement or changing the existing trend_line/horizontal_line/vertical_line implementations.
- **REQ-5** [explicit]: Implement the 7 single-point Annotation tools â arrow_up, arrow_down, flag, price_label, price_note, arrow_marker, callout â as interactive drawing tools placed with a single click (callout requires two clicks for text and anchor point). Acceptance: Each annotation tool places its visual element on single click (callout on two clicks), price_label displays the correct price from the clicked coordinate, and all are visible on chart with registry status 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover post-placement editing of annotation text or properties beyond what the existing text_note flow already supports.
- **REQ-6** [explicit]: Implement the 2 Icon/Media tools â emoji_icon (single click + emoji picker/prompt, default â­) and image_embed (single click + URL prompt, renders as SVG image or placeholder for invalid URLs) â as interactive drawing tools. Acceptance: emoji_icon places the selected emoji at the click point; image_embed renders the image from a valid HTTPS/data:image URL and shows a placeholder box for invalid URLs; both have registry status 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover server-side image upload, image file picker, or emoji picker UI beyond a simple prompt; image_embed only supports URL embedding.
- **REQ-7** [explicit]: Implement the measure tool as a drag-based drawing that shows a dashed rectangle between two points with Îprice, Îprice%, and Îbars displayed in the center. Acceptance: Dragging on the chart with measure tool active creates a dashed rectangle with correct price difference, percentage, and bar count displayed; values recalculate correctly on zoom/pan. Non-goals: Does not cover pixel-based measurement or measurement units other than price/bars.
- **REQ-8** [explicit]: Implement the 6 Channel tools â parallel_channel (3-point), regression_channel (2-point with linear regression on candle closes), standard_error_channel (2-point with std-error width), ascending_channel, descending_channel, flat_channel â as interactive drawing tools with proper channel geometry. Acceptance: Each channel tool creates the correct channel geometry (parallel lines, regression Â± std bands, etc.); regression_channel's slope matches visual expectations on real data; all channels maintain geometry on zoom/pan; registry status is 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover editing channel parameters (k-factor, direction label) after placement beyond the default values.
- **REQ-9** [explicit]: Implement the 8 Fibonacci tools â fibonacci retracement, fib_time_zones, fib_speed_resistance_fan, fib_speed_resistance_arcs, fib_circle, fib_spiral, fib_wedge, fib_channels â with correct mathematical level calculations and the specified color palette per level. Acceptance: Each Fibonacci tool places correctly based on two swing points; levels are mathematically accurate (retracement ratios, Fibonacci number sequences for time zones, correct arc/circle radii); level labels display ratios; the standard color palette is applied; registry status is 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover editable level arrays after placement (future dialog feature) or Fibonacci tools beyond the 8 specified.
- **REQ-10** [explicit]: Implement the 7 Gann/Pitchfork tools â gann_fan (9 rays from P1), gann_box (rectangle + grid), gann_square (square with diagonals), gann_diamond (45Â° rotated rectangle), andrews_pitchfork, schiff_pitchfork, modified_schiff_pitchfork â with correct geometric construction. Acceptance: Gann fan renders 9 symmetric rays at specified slope ratios; pitchfork variants render median + upper/lower parallel lines with correct median origin for each variant; all tools have registry status 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover editable Gann ratios or pitchfork variant switching after placement.
- **REQ-11** [explicit]: Implement the 11 Pattern skeleton tools (elliott_impulse_wave, elliott_corrective_wave, elliott_triangle, elliott_combo, head_and_shoulders, triangle_pattern, double_top, double_bottom, cypher_pattern, abc_pattern, three_drives) as hand-placed multi-point polyline skeletons with labeled points, using a shared renderPolyline function and PATTERN_SPECS config. Non-goals: Does not cover automatic pattern recognition, ML-based detection, or pattern prediction â these are explicitly manual skeleton tools only.
- **REQ-12** [explicit]: Implement the 3 Position/Forecast tools â long_position (green target rect + red stop rect with RR display), short_position (reverse of long), forecast (trend line + funnel uncertainty band) â as interactive drawing tools with risk/reward calculation. Acceptance: Long/short position tools display green/red rectangles with correct RR ratio; forecast renders trend line with widening funnel; all tools have registry status 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover real trading integration, ML-based forecast projections, or editing position parameters after placement.
- **REQ-13** [explicit]: Implement the 3 drag-based Range tools â range_tool (shows Îbars + Îprice + Îprice%), date_range (shows Îbars + date text), price_range (shows Îprice + Îprice%) â with real-time preview during drag and committed rectangle on mouseup. - **REQ-16** [explicit]: Implement the 3 Brush/freehand tools â brush (solid stroke, 2px), highlighter (semi-transparent stroke rgba 0.3, 8px), scribble (solid stroke, 1px, darker color) â using mousedownâmousemoveâmouseup with 16ms throttled sampling, SVG path rendering, and a 500-point maximum per stroke. Acceptance: Pressing mouse and dragging draws a continuous path in real-time; releasing commits the path; highlighter shows visible semi-transparency; brush/scribble show distinct line widths; paths cap at 500 points; registry status is 'supported'. Non-goals: Does not cover anti-aliasing, retina brush rendering, pen pressure sensitivity, or Catmull-Rom smoothing (optional enhancement).
- **REQ-17** [explicit]: Extend useDrawingCreation to support all 5 placement interaction models: single-click, two-click, multi-point (with Enter/double-click early completion and Escape cancel), drag (mousedownâmousemove previewâmouseup commit), and freehand (mousedownâmousemove samplingâmouseup commit). Acceptance: Each interaction model works for its designated tools: single-click for annotations/icons, two-click for trend/fib/gann, multi-point for patterns/pitchfork/triangle/parallelogram, drag for range/measure tools, freehand for brushes; Enter commits multi-point tools with â¥ minPoints; Escape cancels any in-progress drawing. Non-goals: Does not cover undo/redo within a single drawing operation or touch/pen input events.
- **REQ-18** [explicit]: Extend DrawingStyle with optional properties (fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, opacity) and extend DrawingObject with an optional metadata field (DrawingMetadata discriminated union) to carry tool-specific data like Fibonacci levels, Gann ratios, pattern labels, position parameters, regression coefficients, emoji, image URL, and callout anchor â and persist/restore this metadata through the API. Acceptance: DrawingStyle supports the new optional properties; DrawingObject carries metadata for each tool type; metadata is persisted to the server and restored correctly on page refresh; typecheck passes. Non-goals: Does not cover a metadata editing UI/dialog or validation of metadata beyond type safety.
- **REQ-19** [implicit]: Every newly implemented drawing tool must have a working hit-test so it can be selected, moved, and deleted â line-class tools use point-to-line-segment distance â¤ 5px, shape-class tools use point-in-polygon/ellipse, multi-point tools test any segment within 5px, and brush tools test along the path within 5px. Acceptance: Clicking on or near (within 5px) any committed drawing selects it; the drawing can then be deleted, locked, or hidden via the existing store actions; no tool is left without a functional hit-test. Non-goals: Does not cover resizing drawings by dragging handles or multi-selection; hit-test is for selection only.

Acceptance: All 62 new tool types can be persisted via the API and restored on page refresh without server-side validation errors; metadata is stored and retrieved correctly. - **REQ-21** [implicit]: Each implementation phase (P1âP5) must include at least 5 representative tools with end-to-end Playwright tests covering createâzoomâselectâdelete workflows, and all existing tests (unit + e2e) must continue to pass. spec.scope: Fix the UnsupportedFeatureToast being visually obscured by the CookieBanner â the toast (z-index 300, bottom: 20px) is completely covered by the cookie banner (z-index 400, bottom: 0, ~50-70px tall).; Add instant visual click feedback (200ms blue flash animation) to all drawing toolbar buttons, including placeholder tools that are not yet implemented, so users see a response even when toast may be obscured.; Fix the duplicate data-testid="left-drawing-toolbar" â both the ChartWorkspaceShell outer region container and the inner LeftDrawingToolbar component use the same testid, breaking strict-mode Playwright selectors.; Implement the 5 Trend group extension tools â ray_line, extended_line, arrow_line, trend_angle, disjoint_angle â as fully interactive drawing tools with correct geometry (ray extends to viewport edge, extended line spans both viewport boundaries, arrow has triangle arrowhead, trend_angle shows arc + degree label, disjoint_angle shows 3-point V with angle).; Implement the 7 single-point Annotation tools â arrow_up, arrow_down, flag, price_label, price_note, arrow_marker, callout â as interactive drawing tools placed with a single click (callout requires two clicks for text and anchor point).; Implement the 2 Icon/Media tools â emoji_icon (single click + emoji picker/prompt, default â­) and image_embed (single click + URL prompt, renders as SVG image or placeholder for invalid URLs) â as interactive drawing tools.; Implement the measure tool as a drag-based drawing that shows a dashed rectangle between two points with Îprice, Îprice%, and Îbars displayed in the center.; Implement the 6 Channel tools â parallel_channel (3-point), regression_channel (2-point with linear regression on candle closes), standard_error_channel (2-point with std-error width), ascending_channel, descending_channel, flat_channel â as interactive drawing tools with proper channel geometry.; Implement the 8 Fibonacci tools â fibonacci retracement, fib_time_zones, fib_speed_resistance_fan, fib_speed_resistance_arcs, fib_circle, fib_spiral, fib_wedge, fib_channels â with correct mathematical level calculations and the specified color palette per level.; Implement the 7 Gann/Pitchfork tools â gann_fan (9 rays from P1), gann_box (rectangle + grid), gann_square (square with diagonals), gann_diamond (45Â° rotated rectangle), andrews_pitchfork, schiff_pitchfork, modified_schiff_pitchfork â with correct geometric construction.; Implement the 11 Pattern skeleton tools (elliott_impulse_wave, elliott_corrective_wave, elliott_triangle, elliott_combo, head_and_shoulders, triangle_pattern, double_top, double_bottom, cypher_pattern, abc_pattern, three_drives) as hand-placed multi-point polyline skeletons with labeled points, using a shared renderPolyline function and PATTERN_SPECS config.; Implement the 3 Position/Forecast tools â long_position (green target rect + red stop rect with RR display), short_position (reverse of long), forecast (trend line + funnel uncertainty band) â as interactive drawing tools with risk/reward calculation.; Implement the 3 drag-based Range tools â range_tool (shows Îbars + Îprice + Îprice%), date_range (shows Îbars + date text), price_range (shows Îprice + Îprice%) â with real-time preview during drag and committed rectangle on mouseup.; Implement the measured_move tool as a 3-point multi-point tool where the second segment equals the first segment in length but direction is determined by the third point, rendered with a dashed projection line.; Implement the 5 Shape tools â ellipse (bounding box), circle (center + radius), rounded_rectangle (bbox + rx/ry=8), triangle_shape (3-point polygon), parallelogram (3-point with auto-computed 4th point) â with semi-transparent fill and solid stroke.; Implement the 3 Brush/freehand tools â brush (solid stroke, 2px), highlighter (semi-transparent stroke rgba 0.3, 8px), scribble (solid stroke, 1px, darker color) â using mousedownâmousemoveâmouseup with 16ms throttled sampling, SVG path rendering, and a 500-point maximum per stroke.; Extend useDrawingCreation to support all 5 placement interaction models: single-click, two-click, multi-point (with Enter/double-click early completion and Escape cancel), drag (mousedownâmousemove previewâmouseup commit), and freehand (mousedownâmousemove samplingâmouseup commit).; Extend DrawingStyle with optional properties (fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, opacity) and extend DrawingObject with an optional metadata field (DrawingMetadata discriminated union) to carry tool-specific data like Fibonacci levels, Gann ratios, pattern labels, position parameters, regression coefficients, emoji, image URL, and callout anchor â and persist/restore this metadata through the API.; Every newly implemented drawing tool must have a working hit-test so it can be selected, moved, and deleted â line-class tools use point-to-line-segment distance â¤ 5px, shape-class tools use point-in-polygon/ellipse, multi-point tools test any segment within 5px, and brush tools test along the path within 5px.; The persistence layer (server routes and database schema) must accept all 62 newly supported toolType values and the new metadata field â either by whitelisting all DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY ids or by switching to an open-string approach, and by adding a metadata column (jsonb or text-stored JSON).; Each implementation phase (P1âP5) must include at least 5 representative tools with end-to-end Playwright tests covering createâzoomâselectâdelete workflows, and all existing tests (unit + e2e) must continue to pass.; Migrate all 62 placeholder drawing tools to 'supported' status in the DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY as they are implemented, so that clicking them creates real drawings instead of showing the "Not implemented" toast; tools explicitly out-of-scope (pine_compilation, real trading, server image upload) remain as placeholder with friendly toast messages.; Extend DrawingOverlay.tsx with SVG rendering functions for all 62 newly supported tools, including the PendingDrawingRenderer for live preview during creation â no canvas rendering, SVG only.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 7 Gann/Pitchfork tools â gann_fan (9 rays from P1), gann_box (rectangle + grid), gann_square (square with diagonals), gann_diamond (45Â° rotated rectangle), andrews_pitchfork, schiff_pitchfork, modified_schiff_pitchfork â with correct geometric construction.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 3 Position/Forecast tools â long_position (green target rect + red stop rect with RR display), short_position (reverse of long), forecast (trend line + funnel uncertainty band) â as interactive drawing tools with risk/reward calculation.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 5 Shape tools â ellipse (bounding box), circle (center + radius), rounded_rectangle (bbox + rx/ry=8), triangle_shape (3-point polygon), parallelogram (3-point with auto-computed 4th point) â with semi-transparent fill and solid stroke.

requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover shape rotation after placement or editable corner radii beyond the default.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 3 Brush/freehand tools â brush (solid stroke, 2px), highlighter (semi-transparent stroke rgba 0.3, 8px), scribble (solid stroke, 1px, darker color) â using mousedownâmousemoveâmouseup with 16ms throttled sampling, SVG path rendering, and a 500-point maximum per stroke.

requirements_snapshot.description: Extend useDrawingCreation to support all 5 placement interaction models: single-click, two-click, multi-point (with Enter/double-click early completion and Escape cancel), drag (mousedownâmousemove previewâmouseup commit), and freehand (mousedownâmousemove samplingâmouseup commit).

requirements_snapshot.description: Every newly implemented drawing tool must have a working hit-test so it can be selected, moved, and deleted â line-class tools use point-to-line-segment distance â¤ 5px, shape-class tools use point-in-polygon/ellipse, multi-point tools test any segment within 5px, and brush tools test along the path within 5px.
requirements_snapshot.acceptance: Clicking on or near (within 5px) any committed drawing selects it; the drawing can then be deleted, locked, or hidden via the existing store actions; no tool is left without a functional hit-test.

requirements_snapshot.description: Each implementation phase (P1âP5) must include at least 5 representative tools with end-to-end Playwright tests covering createâzoomâselectâdelete workflows, and all existing tests (unit + e2e) must continue to pass.

requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not require a test for every single one of the 62 tools; 5 per phase is the minimum coverage gate.

requirements_snapshot.description: Migrate all 62 placeholder drawing tools to 'supported' status in the DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY as they are implemented, so that clicking them creates real drawings instead of showing the "Not implemented" toast; tools explicitly out-of-scope (pine_compilation, real trading, server image upload) remain as placeholder with friendly toast messages.

requirements_snapshot.description: Extend DrawingOverlay.tsx with SVG rendering functions for all 62 newly supported tools, including the PendingDrawingRenderer for live preview during creation â no canvas rendering, SVG only.

import { sqliteTable, text, integer } from 'drizzle-orm/sqlite-core';

requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover automatic pattern recognition, ML-based detection, or pattern prediction â these are explicitly manual skeleton tools only.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 3 Position/Forecast tools â long_position (green target rect + red stop rect with RR display), short_position (reverse of long), forecast (trend line + funnel uncertainty band) â as interactive drawing tools with risk/reward calculation.
requirements_snapshot.acceptance: Long/short position tools display green/red rectangles with correct RR ratio; forecast renders trend line with widening funnel; all tools have registry status 'supported'.
requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover real trading integration, ML-based forecast projections, or editing position parameters after placement.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 3 drag-based Range tools â range_tool (shows Îbars + Îprice + Îprice%), date_range (shows Îbars + date text), price_range (shows Îprice + Îprice%) â with real-time preview during drag and committed rectangle on mouseup.
requirements_snapshot.acceptance: Each range tool creates via mousedownâmousemoveâmouseup drag with live preview; displays correct computed values after drag ends; registry status is 'supported'.
requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover the measure tool (covered separately) or non-drag range interactions.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the measured_move tool as a 3-point multi-point tool where the second segment equals the first segment in length but direction is determined by the third point, rendered with a dashed projection line.
requirements_snapshot.acceptance: Three clicks create two line segments where the second segment's length equals the first; the second segment is rendered dashed with a "projection" label; registry status is 'supported'.
requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover editing the projection length or direction after placement.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 5 Shape tools â ellipse (bounding box), circle (center + radius), rounded_rectangle (bbox + rx/ry=8), triangle_shape (3-point polygon), parallelogram (3-point with auto-computed 4th point) â with semi-transparent fill and solid stroke.
requirements_snapshot.acceptance: Each shape renders correctly using the appropriate SVG element (ellipse, circle, rect with rx, polygon); fill is semi-transparent, stroke is solid; shapes maintain proportions on zoom/pan; registry status is 'supported'.
requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover shape rotation after placement or editable corner radii beyond the default.

requirements_snapshot.description: Implement the 3 Brush/freehand tools â brush (solid stroke, 2px), highlighter (semi-transparent stroke rgba 0.3, 8px), scribble (solid stroke, 1px, darker color) â using mousedownâmousemoveâmouseup with 16ms throttled sampling, SVG path rendering, and a 500-point maximum per stroke.
requirements_snapshot.acceptance: Pressing mouse and dragging draws a continuous path in real-time; releasing commits the path; highlighter shows visible semi-transparency; brush/scribble show distinct line widths; paths cap at 500 points; registry status is 'supported'.
requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover anti-aliasing, retina brush rendering, pen pressure sensitivity, or Catmull-Rom smoothing (optional enhancement).

requirements_snapshot.description: Extend useDrawingCreation to support all 5 placement interaction models: single-click, two-click, multi-point (with Enter/double-click early completion and Escape cancel), drag (mousedownâmousemove previewâmouseup commit), and freehand (mousedownâmousemove samplingâmouseup commit).
requirements_snapshot.acceptance: Each interaction model works for its designated tools: single-click for annotations/icons, two-click for trend/fib/gann, multi-point for patterns/pitchfork/triangle/parallelogram, drag for range/measure tools, freehand for brushes; Enter commits multi-point tools with â¥ minPoints; Escape cancels any in-progress drawing.

requirements_snapshot.description: Extend DrawingStyle with optional properties (fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, opacity) and extend DrawingObject with an optional metadata field (DrawingMetadata discriminated union) to carry tool-specific data like Fibonacci levels, Gann ratios, pattern labels, position parameters, regression coefficients, emoji, image URL, and callout anchor â and persist/restore this metadata through the API.

requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover a metadata editing UI/dialog or validation of metadata beyond type safety.

requirements_snapshot.description: Every newly implemented drawing tool must have a working hit-test so it can be selected, moved, and deleted â line-class tools use point-to-line-segment distance â¤ 5px, shape-class tools use point-in-polygon/ellipse, multi-point tools test any segment within 5px, and brush tools test along the path within 5px.

requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover resizing drawings by dragging handles or multi-selection; hit-test is for selection only.

requirements_snapshot.description: The persistence layer (server routes and database schema) must accept all 62 newly supported toolType values and the new metadata field â either by whitelisting all DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY ids or by switching to an open-string approach, and by adding a metadata column (jsonb or text-stored JSON).

requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover server-side schema migration tooling or backward compatibility with drawings saved before the metadata field existed.

requirements_snapshot.description: Extend DrawingOverlay.tsx with SVG rendering functions for all 62 newly supported tools, including the PendingDrawingRenderer for live preview during creation â no canvas rendering, SVG only.

 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click
 *
 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.
 * Each group has a primary tool shown in the collapsed toolbar,
 * and all tools in the group appear in the expandable flyout.
 */

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

  id: DrawingTool;
  /** Human-readable label shown in tooltips / ARIA */
  label: string;
  /** CSS class or icon identifier for the tool button */
  icon: string;
  /** Whether the tool produces real drawings, is a placeholder, or is paid */
  status: DrawingToolStatus;
  /** Logical group for flyout toolbar sections */
  group: DrawingToolGroup;
  /** Subgroup within the main group (for further subdivision) */
  subgroup?: string;
  /** Sort order within the toolbar (lower = higher position) */
  sortOrder: number;

  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */
  pointsModel: DrawingPointsModel;
  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */
  shortcutHint?: string;
  /** Context menu capabilities this tool supports */
  contextMenuCapabilities?: string[];
  /** Style schema key for the drawing style editor */

}

  icon: string;

  { id: 'gann', label: 'Gann / Pitchfork', icon: 'andrews-pitchfork' },

  { id: 'position', label: 'Position / Forecast', icon: 'long-position' },
  { id: 'annotations', label: 'Annotations', icon: 'text-note' },
  { id: 'shapes', label: 'Shapes', icon: 'rectangle' },
  { id: 'brushes', label: 'Brushes', icon: 'brush' },
  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Configurable drawing tool registry.
 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click
 *
 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.
 * Each group has a primary tool shown in the collapsed toolbar,
 * and all tools in the group appear in the expandable flyout.
 */

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,
} from '@features/chart/types';

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

export interface DrawingToolConfig {
  /** Matches a value from the DrawingTool type union */
  id: DrawingTool;
  /** Human-readable label shown in tooltips / ARIA */
  label: string;
  /** CSS class or icon identifier for the tool button */
  icon: string;
  /** Whether the tool produces real drawings, is a placeholder, or is paid */
  status: DrawingToolStatus;

];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Drawing tool groups with display metadata.
 * Used by the toolbar to render group headers and flyout panels.
 */
export const DRAWING_TOOL_GROUPS: readonly {
  id: DrawingToolGroup;
  label: string;
  /** Icon for the collapsed group button */
  icon: string;
}[] = [
  { id: 'cursors', label: 'Cursors', icon: 'cursor' },
  { id: 'trend', label: 'Trend Lines', icon: 'trend-line' },
  { id: 'channels', label: 'Channels', icon: 'parallel-channel' },
  { id: 'fibonacci', label: 'Fibonacci', icon: 'fibonacci' },
  { id: 'gann', label: 'Gann / Pitchfork', icon: 'andrews-pitchfork' },
  { id: 'patterns', label: 'Patterns', icon: 'elliott-impulse-wave' },
  { id: 'position', label: 'Position / Forecast', icon: 'long-position' },
  { id: 'annotations', label: 'Annotations', icon: 'text-note' },
  { id: 'shapes', label: 'Shapes', icon: 'rectangle' },
  { id: 'brushes', label: 'Brushes', icon: 'brush' },
  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Configurable drawing tool registry.
 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click
 *
 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.
 * Each group has a primary tool shown in the collapsed toolbar,
 * and all tools in the group appear in the expandable flyout.
 */

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,
} from '@features/chart/types';

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

export interface DrawingToolConfig {
  /** Matches a value from the DrawingTool type union */
  id: DrawingTool;
  /** Human-readable label shown in tooltips / ARIA */
  label: string;
  /** CSS class or icon identifier for the tool button */
  icon: string;
  /** Whether the tool produces real drawings, is a placeholder, or is paid */
  status: DrawingToolStatus;
  /** Logical group for flyout toolbar sections */
  group: DrawingToolGroup;
  /** Subgroup within the main group (for further subdivision) */
  subgroup?: string;
  /** Sort order within the toolbar (lower = higher position) */
  sortOrder: number;
  /** Sort order within the group flyout (lower = first) */
  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */
  pointsModel: DrawingPointsModel;
  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */
  shortcutHint?: string;
  /** Context menu capabilities this tool supports */
  contextMenuCapabilities?: string[];
  /** Style schema key for the drawing style editor */
  styleSchemaKey?: string;
}

/**
 * All drawing tool configurations in toolbar display order.
 * Components import this array and render buttons from it.
 *
 * Groups: cursors, trend, channels, fibonacci, gann, patterns,
 * position, annotations, shapes, brushes, icons
 */

 * Used by the toolbar to render group headers and flyout panels.
 */
export const DRAWING_TOOL_GROUPS: readonly {
  id: DrawingToolGroup;
  label: string;
  /** Icon for the collapsed group button */
  icon: string;
}[] = [
  { id: 'cursors', label: 'Cursors', icon: 'cursor' },
  { id: 'trend', label: 'Trend Lines', icon: 'trend-line' },
  { id: 'channels', label: 'Channels', icon: 'parallel-channel' },
  { id: 'fibonacci', label: 'Fibonacci', icon: 'fibonacci' },
  { id: 'gann', label: 'Gann / Pitchfork', icon: 'andrews-pitchfork' },
  { id: 'patterns', label: 'Patterns', icon: 'elliott-impulse-wave' },
  { id: 'position', label: 'Position / Forecast', icon: 'long-position' },
  { id: 'annotations', label: 'Annotations', icon: 'text-note' },
  { id: 'shapes', label: 'Shapes', icon: 'rectangle' },
  { id: 'brushes', label: 'Brushes', icon: 'brush' },
  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

 * Configurable drawing tool registry.
 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click
 *
 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.
 * Each group has a primary tool shown in the collapsed toolbar,
 * and all tools in the group appear in the expandable flyout.

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

export interface DrawingToolConfig {
  /** Matches a value from the DrawingTool type union */
  id: DrawingTool;

  label: string;
  /** CSS class or icon identifier for the tool button */
  icon: string;
  /** Whether the tool produces real drawings, is a placeholder, or is paid */
  status: DrawingToolStatus;
  /** Logical group for flyout toolbar sections */
  group: DrawingToolGroup;
  /** Subgroup within the main group (for further subdivision) */
  subgroup?: string;
  /** Sort order within the toolbar (lower = higher position) */
  sortOrder: number;
  /** Sort order within the group flyout (lower = first) */
  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */
  pointsModel: DrawingPointsModel;
  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */
  shortcutHint?: string;
  /** Context menu capabilities this tool supports */
  contextMenuCapabilities?: string[];
  /** Style schema key for the drawing style editor */
  styleSchemaKey?: string;
}

  icon: string;

  { id: 'gann', label: 'Gann / Pitchfork', icon: 'andrews-pitchfork' },

  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**

 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click

 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,
} from '@features/chart/types';

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

  /** Matches a value from the DrawingTool type union */
  id: DrawingTool;

  label: string;

  icon: string;

  status: DrawingToolStatus;

  group: DrawingToolGroup;

  subgroup?: string;
  /** Sort order within the toolbar (lower = higher position) */
  sortOrder: number;

  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */
  pointsModel: DrawingPointsModel;
  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */
  shortcutHint?: string;
  /** Context menu capabilities this tool supports */
  contextMenuCapabilities?: string[];
  /** Style schema key for the drawing style editor */
  styleSchemaKey?: string;
}

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

requirements_snapshot.description: Every newly implemented drawing tool must have a working hit-test so it can be selected, moved, and deleted â line-class tools use point-to-line-segment distance â¤ 5px, shape-class tools use point-in-polygon/ellipse, multi-point tools test any segment within 5px, and brush tools test along the path within 5px.

requirements_snapshot.non_goals: Does not cover resizing drawings by dragging handles or multi-selection; hit-test is for selection only.

requirements_snapshot.description: Each implementation phase (P1âP5) must include at least 5 representative tools with end-to-end Playwright tests covering createâzoomâselectâdelete workflows, and all existing tests (unit + e2e) must continue to pass.

/**
 * Configurable drawing tool registry.
 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click
 *
 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.
 * Each group has a primary tool shown in the collapsed toolbar,
 * and all tools in the group appear in the expandable flyout.
 */

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,
} from '@features/chart/types';

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

export interface DrawingToolConfig {
  /** Matches a value from the DrawingTool type union */
  id: DrawingTool;
  /** Human-readable label shown in tooltips / ARIA */
  label: string;
  /** CSS class or icon identifier for the tool button */
  icon: string;
  /** Whether the tool produces real drawings, is a placeholder, or is paid */
  status: DrawingToolStatus;
  /** Logical group for flyout toolbar sections */
  group: DrawingToolGroup;
  /** Subgroup within the main group (for further subdivision) */
  subgroup?: string;
  /** Sort order within the toolbar (lower = higher position) */
  sortOrder: number;
  /** Sort order within the group flyout (lower = first) */
  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */
  pointsModel: DrawingPointsModel;
  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */
  shortcutHint?: string;
  /** Context menu capabilities this tool supports */
  contextMenuCapabilities?: string[];
  /** Style schema key for the drawing style editor */
  styleSchemaKey?: string;
}

];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Drawing tool groups with display metadata.
 * Used by the toolbar to render group headers and flyout panels.
 */
export const DRAWING_TOOL_GROUPS: readonly {
  id: DrawingToolGroup;
  label: string;
  /** Icon for the collapsed group button */
  icon: string;
}[] = [
  { id: 'cursors', label: 'Cursors', icon: 'cursor' },
  { id: 'trend', label: 'Trend Lines', icon: 'trend-line' },
  { id: 'channels', label: 'Channels', icon: 'parallel-channel' },
  { id: 'fibonacci', label: 'Fibonacci', icon: 'fibonacci' },
  { id: 'gann', label: 'Gann / Pitchfork', icon: 'andrews-pitchfork' },
  { id: 'patterns', label: 'Patterns', icon: 'elliott-impulse-wave' },
  { id: 'position', label: 'Position / Forecast', icon: 'long-position' },
  { id: 'annotations', label: 'Annotations', icon: 'text-note' },
  { id: 'shapes', label: 'Shapes', icon: 'rectangle' },
  { id: 'brushes', label: 'Brushes', icon: 'brush' },
  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Configurable drawing tool registry.
 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click
 *
 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.
 * Each group has a primary tool shown in the collapsed toolbar,
 * and all tools in the group appear in the expandable flyout.
 */

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,
} from '@features/chart/types';

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

export interface DrawingToolConfig {
  /** Matches a value from the DrawingTool type union */
  id: DrawingTool;
  /** Human-readable label shown in tooltips / ARIA */
  label: string;
  /** CSS class or icon identifier for the tool button */
  icon: string;
  /** Whether the tool produces real drawings, is a placeholder, or is paid */
  status: DrawingToolStatus;
  /** Logical group for flyout toolbar sections */
  group: DrawingToolGroup;
  /** Subgroup within the main group (for further subdivision) */
  subgroup?: string;
  /** Sort order within the toolbar (lower = higher position) */
  sortOrder: number;
  /** Sort order within the group flyout (lower = first) */
  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */
  pointsModel: DrawingPointsModel;
  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */
  shortcutHint?: string;
  /** Context menu capabilities this tool supports */
  contextMenuCapabilities?: string[];
  /** Style schema key for the drawing style editor */
  styleSchemaKey?: string;
}

/**
 * All drawing tool configurations in toolbar display order.

];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

 *

  id: DrawingTool;

  label: string;

  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */

  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */

  { id: 'brushes', label: 'Brushes', icon: 'brush' },
  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}
