  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Configurable drawing tool registry.
 *
 * Data-driven array of drawing tool config objects consumed by
 * LeftDrawingToolbar and other components. Adding a new tool
 * requires only adding an entry here â no component source changes needed.
 *
 * Each entry's `status` field drives rendering:
 *  - 'supported':  real interactive drawing tool
 *  - 'placeholder': shows unsupported feature boundary on click
 *  - 'premium':     shows paid boundary on click
 *
 * Tools are organized into groups that map to flyout toolbar sections.
 * Each group has a primary tool shown in the collapsed toolbar,
 * and all tools in the group appear in the expandable flyout.
 */

import type {
  DrawingTool,
  DrawingToolGroup,
  DrawingPointsModel,
  DrawingPlacementBehavior,
} from '@features/chart/types';

export type DrawingToolStatus = 'supported' | 'placeholder' | 'premium';

export interface DrawingToolConfig {
  /** Matches a value from the DrawingTool type union */
  id: DrawingTool;
  /** Human-readable label shown in tooltips / ARIA */
  label: string;
  /** CSS class or icon identifier for the tool button */
  icon: string;
  /** Whether the tool produces real drawings, is a placeholder, or is paid */
  status: DrawingToolStatus;
  /** Logical group for flyout toolbar sections */
  group: DrawingToolGroup;
  /** Subgroup within the main group (for further subdivision) */
  subgroup?: string;
  /** Sort order within the toolbar (lower = higher position) */
  sortOrder: number;
  /** Sort order within the group flyout (lower = first) */
  groupSortOrder: number;
  /** How many clicks/points the tool requires to place */
  pointsModel: DrawingPointsModel;
  /** How the drawing is placed on the chart */
  placementBehavior: DrawingPlacementBehavior;
  /** Whether this tool is the primary (shown in collapsed toolbar for its group) */
  isGroupPrimary: boolean;
  /** Stable data-testid for E2E targeting */
  testId: string;
  /** Short keyboard shortcut hint (display only) */
  shortcutHint?: string;
  /** Context menu capabilities this tool supports */
  contextMenuCapabilities?: string[];
  /** Style schema key for the drawing style editor */
  styleSchemaKey?: string;
}

/**
 * All drawing tool configurations in toolbar display order.

export const DRAWING_TOOL_GROUPS: readonly {
  id: DrawingToolGroup;
  label: string;
  /** Icon for the collapsed group button */
  icon: string;
}[] = [
  { id: 'cursors', label: 'Cursors', icon: 'cursor' },
  { id: 'trend', label: 'Trend Lines', icon: 'trend-line' },
  { id: 'channels', label: 'Channels', icon: 'parallel-channel' },
  { id: 'fibonacci', label: 'Fibonacci', icon: 'fibonacci' },
  { id: 'gann', label: 'Gann / Pitchfork', icon: 'andrews-pitchfork' },
  { id: 'patterns', label: 'Patterns', icon: 'elliott-impulse-wave' },
  { id: 'position', label: 'Position / Forecast', icon: 'long-position' },
  { id: 'annotations', label: 'Annotations', icon: 'text-note' },
  { id: 'shapes', label: 'Shapes', icon: 'rectangle' },
  { id: 'brushes', label: 'Brushes', icon: 'brush' },
  { id: 'icons', label: 'Icons / Media', icon: 'emoji-icon' },
];

/**
 * Lookup a drawing tool config by its id.
 */
export function getDrawingToolConfig(id: DrawingTool): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.id === id);
}

/**
 * Get all supported drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getSupportedDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'supported').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get all placeholder drawing tool ids.
 */
export function getPlaceholderDrawingTools(): DrawingTool[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.filter((t) => t.status === 'placeholder').map((t) => t.id);
}

/**
 * Get drawing tools grouped by their group field, preserving groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getDrawingToolsByGroup(): Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> {
  const groups: Record<string, DrawingToolConfig[]> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    const g = tool.group;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g]!.push(tool as DrawingToolConfig);
  }
  // Sort each group by groupSortOrder
  for (const key of Object.keys(groups)) {
    groups[key]!.sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get the primary tool for a given group (the one shown in collapsed toolbar).
 */
export function getGroupPrimaryTool(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig | undefined {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY.find((t) => t.group === group && t.isGroupPrimary);
}

/**
 * Get all tools in a specific group, sorted by groupSortOrder.
 */
export function getToolsInGroup(group: DrawingToolGroup): DrawingToolConfig[] {
  return DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY
    .filter((t) => t.group === group)
    .map((t) => t as DrawingToolConfig)
    .sort((a, b) => a.groupSortOrder - b.groupSortOrder);
}

/**
 * Build a map from placeholder drawing tool id to unsupported feature key.
 * Convention: <tool_id>_drawing (e.g. 'fibonacci' â 'fibonacci_drawing').
 */
export function getPlaceholderFeatureMap(): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const tool of DRAWING_TOOL_REGISTRY) {
    if (tool.status === 'placeholder' || tool.status === 'premium') {
      map[tool.id] = `${tool.id}_drawing`;
    }
  }
  return map;
}
